phases.objective: Classify main-to-feature freshness pull requests as default-branch synchronization without re-evaluating unrelated feature contracts, while preserving fail-closed Production promotion and undeclared feature-branch rules.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The classifier self-test invokes the canonical PR gate in an isolated Git repository with a governed classifier change on main.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: main-to-feature synchronization is classified as default_branch_sync, main-to-Production remains a governed promotion, and undeclared feature branches still fail closed.
steps: Create a governed synthetic baseline and change a scoped runtime classifier file on main.
Evaluate main targeting a non-Production feature branch and require default_branch_sync mode.
Verify the workflow skips complete feature-contract evaluation and journey execution only for default_branch_sync.
Evaluate main targeting Production and retain protected_main promotion identity.
Evaluate an undeclared feature branch targeting main and require bounded rejection.
assertions: Unrelated contracts already present on main are not reclassified as changes owned by a branch freshness PR.
Production promotion is never treated as default_branch_sync.
Undeclared feature delivery remains fail closed.
No deployment, migration apply, database mutation, protected-ref update, provider dispatch, credential read, or external send occurs.

phases.objective: Observe default-branch synchronization classification across repository maintenance branches using canonical evidence.
Retain diagnostics for malformed refs, spoofed Production identities, and missing candidate SHAs.
Validate one non-production main-to-feature synchronization PR.
Preserve exact protected main-to-Production classification without granting merge or deployment authority.
